name: Ending facts
notes: Story bible §4.4 (CANON v1): the world-state facts the endings are assembled from — Horn's fate, the abbot's fate, Vane's fate, breach sealed, Clatter restored, goblin standing, Tansy saved. The headline ending and its epilogue slides are chosen from these.

facts.description: Brother Horn's fate: dead only if the player finished him (Fight & kill, §4.2). Alive picks "Vespers Rung", dead "The Last Warden".
The Sleepless Abbot's fate: laid to rest, defeated, or joined by the player ("The Long Vespers").
Harrow Vane's fate (Framed in Brass, §6.1): exposed, confesses, bribes the player or flees on the mountain road. Siding with him leads to "The Hireling's Silence".
Vane's breach into the Knot is sealed (tunnel collapsed, frozen and shored, or walled by the goblins). Adds "the song never reaches the town again".
Clatter remembers his name, Brother Anselm Hobb (The Name on the Bones, §6.1).
Where the player stands with Mother Kettleback's goblins. Decides who keeps watch in "The Last Warden" and where the player wakes if Horn is dead (§4.5).
The player stopped Tansy before she reached the Cradle in Act III; otherwise the abbot holds her hostage in the final scene (§4.5).
